title: Au Gratin Potatoes
description: Yukon Gold gratin in a garlic bechamel with sharp cheddar and Gruyere, baked in two phases in the Anova Precision Oven.

ingredients.name: Yukon Gold potatoes
ingredients.note: unpeeled or peeled as you prefer, do not rinse

steps.title: Slice
steps.text: Slice {potatoes} 1/8 inch thick on the KWS slicer. Do not rinse them; the surface starch helps thicken the sauce.

steps.title: Start roux
steps.text: In a large saucepan over medium heat, melt {butter}. Add {garlic} and cook 1 minute, stirring.
Whisk in {flour} and cook 2 minutes to make a blond roux.

steps.title: Build sauce
steps.text: Slowly whisk in {cream} and {broth}. Simmer 5 minutes, whisking, until it coats the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Add cheese
steps.text: Remove the pan from heat. Stir in {cheddar} and {gruyere} until melted and smooth.

steps.title: Layer
steps.text: Layer one third of the potatoes in the dish, spoon over one third of the sauce, and repeat for 3 layers total, finishing with sauce.

steps.title: Phase 1: covered
steps.text: Cover the dish tightly with foil. Bake in the Anova Precision Oven at 325°F, 50% steam, for 45 minutes with the bottom drip pan installed.

steps.title: Phase 2: uncovered
steps.text: Remove the foil. Bake at 400°F, 0% steam, for 20 to 25 minutes until golden. For extra color, broil the last 3 to 4 minutes.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Rest 15 minutes so the sauce sets before serving.

notes: Quantities are starting points (the saved version had technique but no amounts); adjust to taste. Make ahead: assemble, refrigerate, and add about 10 minutes to the covered phase. Reheat leftovers in the APO at 325°F, 30% steam, 15 minutes. Yukons hold their shape better than russets in a gratin.
